name: Wdg
description: Configuration of the Wdg (Watchdog driver) module.

children.name: WdgDemEventParameterRefs
children.description: Container for the references to DemEventParameter elements which shall be invoked using the API Dem_ReportErrorStatus in case the corresponding error occurs. The EventId is taken from the referenced DemEventParameter's DemEventId value.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The standardized errors are provided in the container and can be extended by vendor-specific error references.

children.name: WDG_E_DISABLE_REJECTED
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "Initialization or mode switch failed because it would disable the watchdog" has occurred.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: WDG_E_MODE_FAILED
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "Setting a watchdog mode failed (during initialization or mode switch)" has occurred.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: WdgGeneral
children.description: All general parameters of the watchdog driver are collected here.

children.name: WdgDevErrorDetect
children.description: Switches the Default Error Tracer (Det) detection and notification ON or OFF.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: WdgDisableAllowed
children.description: Compile switch to allow / forbid disabling the watchdog driver during runtime.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: True: Disabling the watchdog driver at runtime is allowed. False: Disabling the watchdog driver at runtime is not allowed.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: WdgIndex
children.description: Represents the watchdog driver's ID so that it can be referenced by the watchdog interface.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: WdgInitialTimeout
children.description: The initial timeout (sec) for the trigger condition to be initialized during Init function. It shall be not larger than WdgMaxTimeout.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: WdgMaxTimeout
children.description: The maximum timeout (sec) to which the watchdog trigger condition can be initialized.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: WdgRunArea
children.description: Represents the watchdog driver execution area is either from ROM(Flash) or RAM as required with the particular microcontroller.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: WdgTriggerLocation
children.description: Location (memory address) of the watchdog trigger routine.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: WdgVersionInfoApi
children.description: Compile switch to enable / disable the version information API

metadata.INTRODUCTION: * True: API enabled * False: API disabled
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: WdgPublishedInformation
children.description: Container holding all Wdg specific published information parameters

children.name: WdgTriggerMode
children.description: Watchdog trigger mode (toggle/window/both)

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PUBLISHED-INFORMATION VARIANT-LINK-TIME PUBLISHED-INFORMATION VARIANT-POST-BUILD PUBLISHED-INFORMATION VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.LITERALS: WDG_BOTH AUTOSAR_ECUC WDG_TOGGLE AUTOSAR_ECUC WDG_WINDOW AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: WdgSettingsConfig
children.description: Configuration items for the different watchdog settings, including those for external watchdog hardware.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Note: All postbuild parameters are handled via this container.

children.name: WdgDefaultMode
children.description: Default mode for watchdog driver initialization.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.LITERALS: WDGIF_FAST_MODE AUTOSAR_ECUC WDGIF_OFF_MODE AUTOSAR_ECUC WDGIF_SLOW_MODE AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: WdgExternalConfiguration
children.description: Configuration items for an external watchdog hardware

children.name: WdgExternalContainerRef
children.description: Reference to either

metadata.INTRODUCTION: - a DioChannelGroup container in case the hardware watchdog is connected via DIO pins - an SpiSequenceConfiguration container in case the watchdog hardware is accessed via SPI
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: WdgSettingsFast
children.description: Hardware dependent settings for the watchdog driver's "fast" mode.

children.name: WdgSettingsOff
children.description: Hardware dependent settings for the watchdog driver's "off" mode.

children.name: WdgSettingsSlow
children.description: Hardware dependent settings for the watchdog driver's "slow" mode.
